title: BTC-ETH failed breakout with open-interest rebuild
hypothesis: A previously non-crowded BTC-ETH breakout should be downgraded from TREND_UP to REVERSAL_RISK or NO_EDGE when price loses the declared breakout support while contract open interest rebuilds materially and ETH confirmation deteriorates; this state may identify stale continuation labels without forcing a short.
mechanism: The earlier continuation thesis relied on price rising without proportional leverage expansion. Since that observation, BTC fell below the predeclared 85,900 support while OKX BTC contract open interest rose about 3.1%, and ETH also fell from its confirmation level. The combination contradicts the original spot-led mechanism and is consistent with new leverage entering a failed breakout. Falling funding and a still-negative premium mean the new OI may include shorts and do not justify a direct short signal, so the appropriate directional state is reversal risk/no edge rather than TREND_DOWN.
exact_rule_or_model_spec: Paper-only state-transition detector. Let t0 be a prior SPOT_LED_BREAKOUT candidate. FAILED_BREAKOUT_OI_REBUILD = age(t0)<=6h AND completed_15m_close < support_t0 AND no completed_15m reclaim above support_t0 AND OI_contract(t)/OI_contract(t0)-1 >= 0.02 AND BTC_price(t)/BTC_price(t0)-1 < 0 AND ETH_price(t)/ETH_price(t0)-1 < 0. Set regime=REVERSAL_RISK and expected_trade_expression=NEUTRAL. Do not automatically short, close, resize, or suppress a live trade. In paper research, compare stale continuation scoring with a state reset to NO_EDGE; if baseline frequency preservation is required, permit only same-side candidate rotation where raw WhaleRadar score is at least 95% of baseline and all cost/liquidity gates pass.
required_data: Point-in-time BTC and ETH perpetual prices and completed 15-minute candles
Prospectively timestamped contract open interest with firstObservedAt and ingestedAt
Funding rate and perpetual premium/index basis
Taker flow, L2 depth, spread, liquidation stream and top-50 breadth for confirmation
The original candidate timestamp, support level and feature snapshot
transaction_cost_implications: A failed-breakout reset may avoid paying spread and slippage to chase a stale continuation, but any delay, veto, exit or reversal also has opportunity and execution costs. Test score-reset, same-side rotation and unchanged-baseline arms separately. Include actual fee tier, funding, Q-sized book-walk, missed-move cost, and 1.5x/2x slippage stress; never assume a forced exit or short is costless.
expected_benefit: Reduce stale trend-up classifications after the causal mechanism changes, lowering false-breakout drawdown while preserving useful trade frequency through a score reset or same-side rotation rather than an automatic hard veto.
risks: The support breach may be temporary and had not been independently confirmed with a completed 15-minute candle in the accessible snapshot. Rising OI is direction-ambiguous and may represent new shorts, hedges, or spread trades. Funding fell and premium remained negative, which contradicts a simple crowded-long interpretation. Evidence is concentrated on OKX because Binance public endpoints were inaccessible from the research environment, and no fresh taker, liquidation, breadth, L2 or Polymarket probability-velocity confirmation was available.
falsification_criteria: REJECT if the state reset does not improve matched-frequency net PnL, profit factor or maximum drawdown in both locked OOS periods; if benefit disappears after 1.5x costs; if retained trade count falls below 98%; if the effect is explained by price-only support loss with no incremental value from OI and ETH; if prospective OI fails to reproduce the relation; or if gains come from fewer than five independent event clusters.
validation_plan: Use causal snapshots with usableAt<=decision_time. Develop thresholds on 2024-2025, validate unchanged on January-June 2026, and use July-September 2026 once as a locked test only where point-in-time OI semantics are verified. Freeze the detector and run at least 90 future paper days. Compare BASELINE_STALE_TREND, PRICE_ONLY_RESET, PRICE_X_OI_RESET, PRICE_X_ETH_RESET, FULL_FAILED_BREAKOUT_RESET, SAME_SIDE_ROTATION, HARD_VETO_SHADOW and matched-frequency random controls. Report net PnL, profit factor, maximum drawdown, MAE/MFE, retention, trade count, capital utilization, implementation shortfall and cost sensitivity with day/event-block bootstrap.
minimum_sample: At least 200 prior breakout candidates, 75 completed support-loss events with OI rebuilding at least 2%, 50 events with simultaneous ETH deterioration, 500 eligible baseline decisions, and at least 90 prospective calendar days; extend until all counts are met.

primary_drivers: BTC broke below the declared 85,900 support
price fell while multi-hour OI remained elevated
no taker, liquidation or breadth confirmation
24-hour price remains above the rolling open
macro and cross-exchange confirmation are absent

contradictions: BTC remained above its 24-hour open, so the broader daily move was still positive despite the failed intraday breakout.
Open interest rebuilt materially from the original snapshot, but funding fell and premium stayed negative, so OI direction cannot be identified as new longs.
ETH weakened with BTC, but remained above its 24-hour open.
No fresh taker-flow, liquidation, breadth, full-depth or reliable Polymarket probability-change confirmation was available.
invalidation_triggers: Cancel REVERSAL_RISK if BTC completes a 15-minute reclaim above 85,900 and then holds above it for another completed 15-minute observation.
Flip back toward conditional TREND_UP only if BTC reclaims the breakout area, ETH confirms, and OI growth is accompanied by positive breadth or taker-flow confirmation.
Escalate toward TREND_DOWN only if BTC breaks the 24-hour open/low area with negative breadth and sell-flow or liquidation confirmation.
Treat the current signal as NO_EDGE if OI falls rapidly while price returns to the prior range, indicating a leverage flush rather than sustained reversal.

BTC also traded below the packet's declared 85,900 invalidation support. Funding declined and premium remained negative, so this invalidates the non-crowded continuation mechanism but does not establish a direct short.
